summary: Controller nodes broadcast all WebSocket messages to each other so any node can serve any browser WebSocket client; configure this in /etc/tower/conf.d/websocket_config.py on all nodes and restart. Nodes are discovered through Instance records; broadcasting should stay on a private trusted subnet, since disabling HTTPS sends playbook stdout unencrypted.
questions: How do controller nodes share WebSocket messages?
